body_markdown:
# Day 2: Learn 20 Common English Words

Today you will learn 20 useful words that appear in everyday conversations. Read each meaning and example. Then make your own sentence.

## 20 useful words

| Word | Simple meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Accept | Say yes to something | I accept your offer. |
| Ask | Request information | Please ask a question. |
| Bring | Carry something here | Bring your notebook. |
| Choose | Select one thing | Choose a book. |
| Clean | Remove dirt | Clean your desk. |
| Complete | Finish something | Complete your work. |
| Decide | Make a choice | I will decide today. |
| Explain | Make something clear | Please explain this rule. |
| Find | Discover or locate | I cannot find my keys. |
| Help | Give support | Can you help me? |
| Improve | Make better | I want to improve my English. |
| Join | Become part of something | I will join the meeting. |
| Learn | Gain knowledge | We learn every day. |
| Listen | Pay attention to sound | Listen carefully. |
| Need | Require something | I need some water. |
| Offer | Present something | They offer good service. |
| Prepare | Get ready | Prepare your notes. |
| Remember | Keep something in your mind | Remember this word. |
| Speak | Say words aloud | Speak slowly. |
| Visit | Go to see a place or person | We visit our friends. |

## 1. Read and repeat

Read each word aloud. Pay attention to its pronunciation. If you are unsure, use a dictionary with audio.

## 2. Make your own sentences

Choose any five words from the table and write one original sentence for each.

## 3. Quick vocabulary check

Complete the sentences:
1. Please ___ carefully. (listen / visit)
2. I want to ___ my English. (improve / bring)
3. Can you ___ me with this task? (help / choose)
4. Please ___ your notebook. (bring / decide)
5. I will ___ the meeting tomorrow. (join / clean)

Answers: 1. listen, 2. improve, 3. help, 4. bring, 5. join.

## Today's challenge

Use at least five of these words in conversation or in a short paragraph.

## Revision tip

Review yesterday's self-introduction and include two new words in it.

faq.question: Should I memorise all 20 words today?
faq.answer: Read them, understand the examples and practise using a few at a time. Review them again tomorrow.

faq.question: How can I remember new vocabulary?
faq.answer: Create your own sentences and use the words in real conversations or writing.

faq.question: Do I need to learn pronunciation too?
faq.answer: Yes. Listen to each word and repeat it aloud.
